audit.whatIsWrong: Five rows were wrong in both layers: Levels 2-3 read Ziggs while whys[1] and whys[2] call them even, Levels 4-5 read Skill while whys[3] says your all-in bursts him, first item read Skill while whys[5] says you spike ahead, and 2+ items read Ziggs while whys[6] says it evens out.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Ziggs / Skill / Skill / Wukong / Ziggs / Wukong / Skill and matches the content prose row for row. No mirror exists yet, so this sets the reference for ziggs__wukong.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2 and 6 set to Skill and rows 3 and 5 to Wukong as matched phases[N].side + win[N] pairs, all seven ratings normalised, and the stage explanations rewritten with the mechanic behind each row.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why was the generic 'Cyclone's double knockup wins every committed brawl' line on Ziggs' strongest row, and phases[6].why quoted a carry-threat number rather than saying what two items change.
audit.why: Mega Inferno Bomb is thrown 5000 units on 120/95/70s and Satchel Charge knocks you away every time you close, which is why Level 6 is his. At two items the answer is MR and flanking, not walking the lane, which is what levels the row.
audit.corrected: Level 6 stage now names the 5000-range ultimate and the Satchel knockback; the 2+ item stage names MR and flank angles as the reason it evens.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] 'W-decoy his answer', dontsFull[0] 'Burn the W clone early', dontsFull[1] 'Trade into his Satchel Charge' and dontsFull[2] 'Engage without E attack speed' all carried bodies copied from other rows. Satchel's 20s rank-1 cooldown, its early-detonation option, Bouncing Bomb's 6s, the Minefield's diminishing repeat damage and Short Fuse's cooldown refund were all absent (packet: sequencingCues 1).
audit.why: Riot's text: Satchel detonates after a delay or on re-activation, knocking both of you away, on 20/18/16/14/12s. Bouncing Bomb is 6s at rank 1, so the gap between casts is the walk-up window. Hexplosive Minefield's successive detonations on the same target deal reduced damage. Short Fuse's cooldown is reduced whenever he uses an ability, so a Ziggs who has just cast twice has an empowered auto ready.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns now carry Satchel's 20s and knock-both-away behaviour, Bouncing Bomb's 6s and the Minefield's 16s with diminishing repeats; dosFull[2].d states the early detonation; dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d state what the clone is for and what the knockback costs you; dontsFull[2].d states the Short Fuse refund.

audit.why: packet.suspectNames flags "Use Satchel Charge" in wants.foe[1]. Satchel Charge is Ziggs' real W; 'Use' is just the preceding verb. False positive; left unchanged.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Ziggs must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: A skill trade: Bouncing Bomb is 6s at rank 1, so step behind the wave once it lands and walk up in that gap.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Satchel Charge's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your all-in window: once you are in melee he has only a 20s Satchel to answer with, and the minefield will not stop you.

edits.before: Cyclone’s double knockup wins every committed brawl. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ziggs's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: At 6 he pulls away: Mega Inferno Bomb reaches 5000 units, and Satchel knocks you off him every time you close.

edits.before: Black Cleaver is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Satchel Charge's cooldown.
edits.after: Black Cleaver is your spike — all-in the moment Satchel goes on its 20s and he cannot reset the gap.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Ziggs carry threat 7.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: It evens at two items: build MR and take flank angles instead of walking the lane, and his poke stops deciding the fight.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Satchel Charge: 20s at rank 1, knocks you both away and can be detonated early — the window that decides the lane. - Bouncing Bomb: 6s at rank 1, so walk up right after it lands. - Hexplosive Minefield: 16s, and repeat mines hit you for less.

edits.before: His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Satchel is 20s at rank 1 and it knocks you both away — walk at him the moment he spends it.

edits.before: Ziggs wastes Satchel Charge — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: He detonates Satchel early to peel — make the clone eat it.

edits.before: That is Ziggs's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: The clone is the thing that survives his Satchel — hold it until he commits.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: It knocks you away and resets the gap he needs to keep poking.

edits.before: Burning W before the trade starts — the clone IS your defense, and committing without it means eating his full combo.
edits.after: Short Fuse returns faster every time he casts, so a Ziggs who just used two spells hits harder than you expect.
